verdict.rationale: Transactional/marketing separation is a fair question for an email platform like Klaviyo, so the axis applies. However, the pack does not document separate transactional templates, suppression rules, sending reputation, or delivery to unsubscribed contacts. Event-triggered flows that send branded notifications, and an AI agent that sends order updates, are adjacent features and do not show the separation the story requires.

support.subject: As an ops user, transactional email is kept separate from marketing — its own templates, suppression rules, and reputation — so a receipt still delivers to an unsubscribed contact
